latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Text to Video Narration AI.

- Converts text scripts (TXT, DOCX, PDF, SRT) up to 200MB into narrated videos with AI-generated audio and visuals.
- Simple cloud-based setup; automatic token management and session creation.
- Supports export to 1080p MP4 and other common formats; typical processing time is 1–2 minutes.
- Provides credit checking, multi-file uploading, and session-based timeline editing.
- Detailed error handling and feedback for unsupported files, expired tokens, and export issues.
- User-friendly prompts and action routing streamline upload, edit, preview, and download workflows.
